description: The direct-manager check is skipped when the worker has no manager_id, so any worker may decide such a request.
The tenant check only runs when tenant_id is supplied, so a request with no tenant_id reads this tenant's payroll data.
persona is interpolated into the SQL string by f-string instead of being bound as a parameter, allowing SQL injection.
Coverage passes only when strictly above the floor, but the rule and message say at or above, so exactly-at-floor coverage is flagged.
Only an explicit email_verified=false is refused; a token with the claim missing or non-boolean is accepted, so the check fails open.
Bearer token is compared with == instead of a constant-time compare, enabling timing attacks.
